newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hong Fok reduces stake in Winfoong.
newsitem.headline: Hong Fok reduces stake in Winfoong.

text.p: Hong Fok Corp said on Wednesday it has reduced its stake in its associate company Winfoong International Ltd to about 41.32 percent from about 48.54 percent.
It said in a statement that the reduction was because Winfoong had issued 100 million new ordinary shares to Barragan Trading Corp in exchange for Hong Kong $74 million of convertible notes.
The notes were converted into shares of Winfoong at the rate of HK$0.74 each.
Hong Fok said it expected to record an extraordinary loss of approximately Singapore $7.65 million from the dilution of its stake for the financial year ending December 31, 1996.
